data.name: Iver
data.gender_notes: Iver is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse words ‘Yggdrasil’ and ‘Ipor’, meaning ‘the protector of the divine tree’. In Norse mythology, Yggdrasil is the tree of life that connects all realms of existence. The name Iver carries the meaning “Divine protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Iver usually hope their child will grow to embody divine protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iver total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
